title: Linearity indices of two rotation-symmetric bent families
summary: Determine the exact linearity indices of an explicit rotation-symmetric bent dual pair and decide whether both members are ell-optimal.

formal_statement.body: Let $n=2m\ge 8$, with subscripts modulo $n$, and define $f_m,\widetilde f_m\in\mathcal B_n$ by $f_m(x)=\sum_{i=0}^{m-1}x_ix_{m+i}+\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}x_ix_{i+1}\cdots x_{i+m-2}x_{i+m}$ and $\widetilde f_m(x)=\sum_{i=0}^{m-1}x_ix_{m+i}+\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}x_ix_{i+1}\cdots x_{i+m-2}x_{i+n-2}$. For $g\in\mathcal B_n$, set $\operatorname{ind}(g)=\max\{\dim U:U\le\mathbb F_2^n\text{ and }D_aD_b g=0\text{ for all }a,b\in U\}$. Determine $\operatorname{ind}(f_m)$ and $\operatorname{ind}(\widetilde f_m)$ for every $m\ge4$, and decide whether each equals $1$ (ell-optimality).

scope.domain: Rotation-symmetric Boolean bent functions and M-subspaces
assumptions: The two families are exactly those in source Eqs. (IV.1) and (IV.2)
Linearity index is the maximum dimension of an M-subspace
parameters: The primal and dual source families
scope.unresolved_remainder: The source proves both members of the dual pair lie outside the completed Maiorana--McFarland class, so their indices are below m, but their exact indices and ell-optimality remain unknown for the full parameter family.

progress.summary: The source proves exclusion from the completed Maiorana--McFarland class and poses the exact-index and ell-optimality questions as Open Problem 3.
